title: Cowan Foundation donation names new recreation centre
subtitle: Special meeting also authorized a closed session on legal matters and a potential land disposition.
overview: Council held a special meeting to approve a $2.5 million donation from The Cowan Foundation. In recognition, the City's newest indoor recreation complex and indoor turf fieldhouse, at 1955 Fischer-Hallman Road, will be named the Cowan Recreation Centre and Cowan Fieldhouse. The facility is still under construction. The decision was carried {{vote:m1}}.

The Mayor and Clerk are authorized to sign a Donation Agreement, which must satisfy the City Solicitor. The approval follows discussion at the August 11, 2025 in-camera meeting. Members of the Cowan family and the foundation's executive director were acknowledged at the meeting.

For residents, the gift supports a major new public recreation facility and sets its name. Council then recessed and reconvened, and approved a closed session {{vote:m2}} to consider two solicitor-client privilege matters, one involving potential litigation, and a potential land disposition. The minutes report no decisions from that session. Three councillors were absent.

decisions.detail: Council authorized the Mayor and Clerk to sign a Donation Agreement for a $2.5 million gift, naming the new facility the Cowan Recreation Centre and Cowan Fieldhouse, subject to the City Solicitor's satisfaction.
